avenues.name: Proof of personhood
avenues.thesis: Per-person issuance stands or falls on sybil resistance; biometric (Worldcoin), social-graph (Duniter/Ğ1), and adjudication (Proof of Humanity) have all shipped — none has uniqueness, privacy, and scale at once.

avenues.name: Monetary levers
avenues.thesis: Reserve-yield issuance (GoodDollar) and demurrage (Gesell/Freicoin/Wörgl/Sarafu) exist as mechanisms; none has defended a dividend's real purchasing power at scale.

avenues.name: Work incentives (the pilots)
avenues.thesis: Finland, Kenya, Stockton, and Alaska show small-to-null labor-supply effects at modest transfers; no pilot reaches the living-wage regime. Cited; awaiting this dossier's own citation audit.

avenues.name: Beyond currency: real assets
avenues.thesis: Sovereign-wealth dividends, Harberger/COST taxation, and RWA tokenization exist independently; coupling non-currency asset redistribution to a per-person dividend is the dossier's exploratory design frontier.

avenues.name: The graveyard
avenues.thesis: Proof of Humanity's UBI token, Circles UBI, and Freicoin each failed on the demand side — value or acceptance — never on distribution.

avenues.name: The central challenge
avenues.thesis: Whether protocol levers — issuance, demurrage, fee recycling, reserve backing — can sustain a UBI's real purchasing power while preserving work incentives; criteria to be set in the reserved blueprint.

checks._comment: Single source of truth for the consistency-check RULES. Both index.html's console and verification/verify_numbers.py read these, so a threshold can never drift between the page and the verifier. Change a rule HERE and both sides enforce it on next run. (The check LOGIC is still written in each language — see AUTHORING.md — but the rules it enforces live only here.)
